run_extract_pr_from_circle_pull_request: run the script to extract the pull request number from the CIRCLE_PULL_REQUEST environment variable
run_extract_pr_from_circle_branch: run the script to extract the pull request number from the CIRCLE_BRANCH environment variable when it starts with pull/
run_extract_pr_fallback: run the script to extract the pull request number with fallback from CIRCLE_PULL_REQUEST to CIRCLE_BRANCH
review_extract_pr_logic: review the script that extracts pull request numbers from CircleCI environment variables
summarize_extract_pr_script: summarize the script that extracts pull request numbers from CircleCI CI/CD environment variables
